g.text: Figure 1. Percent of phrase playback spent on each causal candidate. Points are the whole-phrase
mean for one participant (session b011a59b, 4 October 2026). Whiskers are the 95% CI from the 100 ms
slices inside that phrase. The gray band marks 0–100% of the phrase. An interval that leaves the band
means those slices do not agree. Thin is “cause to V”; thick is the verb alone. Distal is the left
candidate and proximal the right candidate in the standard layout.
